name: MapToolbar
intent: A vertical floating toolbar for a map: split-view toggle, "my location", zoom (`VerticalZoomTools`), and a compass — each rendered as its own pill in the shared vertical-zoom-tools style. The compass is a separate pill below the zoom control. Every section is optional and appears only when its handler is provided, so the toolbar grows with the features you wire up.

props.name: zoomLevel
props.description: Current zoom multiplier (1 = 100%), used to auto-derive the zoom buttons' enabled state.

props.name: bearing
props.description: Current map bearing in degrees (0 = north) for the compass needle.
